title: Join the Haaland Safari in Norway
original_title: Följ med på Haaland-safari i Norge
overview: A few miles south of Stavanger lies the small farming community of Bryne – the place that raised one of the world’s most talked-about people right now: Erling Braut Haaland. SVT follows in his footsteps to uncover what has shaped the world’s best striker. What’s really in the milk in Bryne? An intimate journey to the football phenomenon’s roots and the small village that made him.
